scope: Normal spawned recorder with real Tk input, automatic analysis and seven seats. Same frozen histories at 1001/5001/10001 events. Complete new-shoe and zero-burn claims apply only to owned synthetic fixtures.
sample_definition: One AVAILABLE request/prefix is one decision batch. Each group has 3 distinct request/prefix batches; repeated synthetic composition is not statistically independent live blackjack. Per-input timings have 45 or 48 samples and must not be treated as decision sample counts.
percentile_note: Nearest-rank percentiles describe measured samples. With only 3 decision batches per group, p95/p99 equal the measured maximum, not a reliable live tail estimate.
component_note: Worker replay/prefix/append fields total calls per input. Recovery includes nested validation; zero means no recovery on that request, with executed-only recovery separately listed. Input-to-commit includes queue wait. Append field includes suffix/baseline validation and SQLite commit. IPC combines logging, serialization, transfer, deserialization and scheduling; overlapping parent callbacks/publication are not additive.
